note: Double service doors at the ends of the secret hallway on each floor. Read by scripts/build-blockout.mts. Meters, x east, y north (same as the floor plans). x,y is the centre of the door line. axis 'x' = the door spans east-west across a hall that runs north-south; axis 'y' = it spans north-south across a hall that runs east-west. width is the hall width. swing is the side the leaves swing toward when open (N, S, E, W). 'leadsTo': 'garage' marks the door that is the way into the procedural parking-garage level (the transition is not wired yet). All start closed; the mall opens and closes them (see src/engine/doors.ts).
